decisions.finding: Redundant complete-bank copying and repeated Apple preparation
decisions.implementation: Reserve replacement storage without copying; initialize all live Android steps and header; Apple preflight resets/prepares once and commits prepared storage. Generic partial writers retain inheritance, validation and atomic failures.
evidence: generic and replacement publication concurrency, 1000 cycles each

decisions.implementation: ARM64 size-optimized Release time blocks reuse coefficients for eight/four samples and preserve the own-Apple fused lane accumulation. Stereo and other Apple build modes stream. Spatial tiles stop before native attacks and use saved sample clocks. Helpers stay on the stack and never escape.
decisions.compatibility: Compatible under the frozen Release toolchain; other build modes retain streaming FIR
decisions.rejectedExperiments: All-FMA at O3 and Android-style mixed accumulation at Apple -Os changed sample bits and were rejected. The first whole-callback helper prototype changed stereo timing by +206%/+20% and was rejected. Protected FIR alone still regresses idle CPU 20.13% and one stereo voice 2.89% in long warmed trials; it is not accepted independently. The final F02/F03/F04 bundle improves those cases by 29.51%/6.19% and clears every final alarm.

decisions.compatibility: Compatible; fractional sends and complete hidden state compared byte-for-byte

decisions.finding: Empty poll/prune allocations and unknown-ID position retention
decisions.implementation: Return null for empty JNI completion polls, already handled by Java; skip empty-generation pruning; never retain a position for an unknown generation. Keep the 10 ms event cadence and queued/active ownership.
decisions.compatibility: Compatible; valid unknown edits remain queued accepted no-ops, including existing queue failure behavior
decisions.evidence: Idle JNI regression observes zero NewDoubleArray calls and one durable stop delivery. Apple regression checks 1,000 unknown edits, queued/active retention and retirement. 100,000 empty prune calls use about 96% less CPU in the isolated host experiment; retained allocations are measured within one autorelease pool, not claimed as physical memory savings.

decisions.reason: Preserve callback preallocation and current layout; no physical whole-process memory evidence justifies dynamic capacity storage.
decisions.followup: Physical footprint/RSS peaks and recovery at supported device rates; any future capacity change must preserve 1–4 slots and all limits.
